about: Catalogue of everything SonoraOS needs, front -> module -> item. Rendered by tools/progress.py into planning/PROGRESS.md. An item is done only when it is merged to main AND verified; done needs evidence, doing needs a branch. Sizes: S=1, M=3, L=8 points. Two fronts, two milestones (owner, 2026-10-13): Complete DAW, built first, then OS packaging. 'phase' is the stage in planning/ROADMAP.md. 'ref' cites the Avid or Apple documentation the feature's behaviour comes from (PT-RG: Pro Tools Reference Guide; LP-UG: Logic Pro for Mac 12.3 User Guide); behaviour only, never code or content (ADR-0004).

phases.1: DAW 1: engine core, contracts, model, session file
phases.2: DAW 2: editing and mixing in the Qt UI, on the laptop
phases.3: DAW 3: recording workflow, playlists and comping
phases.4: DAW 4: full mixer, processing graph and automation
phases.9: DAW 9: Logic creative tools and content
phases.10: DAW 10: control surfaces, sync and video
phases.12: OS 1: bootable image and target hardware
